verdict.verdict: PARTIALLY RETRACTED, CAUSE CORRECTED: the frozen random projection is a real and large fix to the representation (identity 0.362 -> 0.717), but the operative variable is NOT afferent convergence. It is receptive-field POLARITY: an absolute-value projection with one pixel per neuron and NO convergence scores 0.640, while the same projection with unit (all-positive) polarity scores 0.362 and a pure pixel-routing permutation scores 0.380. The identity input path is rectified (pixels are in [0,1], so every receptive field is positive), whereas real cortical receptive fields are signed.
verdict.consequence_verdict: STANDS: the projection does NOT rescue continual learning -- the substrate remains 45.27 points behind the parameter-matched MLP on Permuted-MNIST
